description: A Long-Short strategy based on the Short Interest Effect adapted for the A-Share market. The strategy identifies stocks with potentially high (short) and low (long) short interest ratios, rebalancing monthly. Uses A-Share specific models for fees, settlement (T+1), and buying power.
risk_controls: Trailing Stop: 5% pullback from peak price for longs, 5% rally from trough for shorts.
Max Drawdown: 20% portfolio level drawdown triggers full liquidation.
Position Sizing: Orders rounded to nearest 100 shares (A-Share lot size).

data_requirements.reason: Required for valuation, return calculation, and executing orders.
Core signal for ranking stocks (High vs Low Short Interest). Note: Simulated via proxy in this draft due to standard data constraints.
